beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Readers learn to ask what was measured and which alternatives were considered.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This prepares the central test of whether the explanation actually tracks the model.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Counterfactual explanations consider changes associated with a different outcome under specified conditions.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The nearest mathematical change may still be unavailable to a real person.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Feasible recourse requires attention to constraints, actions, and the setting around the model.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book also examines concepts and training data as different explanatory objects.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: These approaches answer related questions without becoming interchangeable measures of the same thing.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The chapter sequence helps readers see why method choice follows the explanation contract.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The validation chapters ask explanations to survive tests beyond visual plausibility.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: If model parameters are randomized, an explanation should respond when its claimed basis disappears.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Other tests examine sensitivity, fidelity, human use, or behavior under changing conditions.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: No single test can certify every property an audience might care about.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book therefore assembles evidence around a specific claim and intended use.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its practical lesson is to evaluate explanations as carefully as the predictions they accompany.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Foundation models intensify the temptation to confuse a fluent account with direct introspection.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A generated rationale is itself an output requiring evidence about what it represents.
